bio.text: Walter "Walt" Blackman is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 7; he assumed office on January 13, 2025.
He previously represented District 6 in the Arizona House from 2019 to 2023.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1995 to 2016, received the Bronze Star Medal and the Meritorious Service Medal, and graduated from Lakewood University in 2023.
In 2016, he founded W.B. Inclusion & Diversity Consulting and Victim Advocacy Inc.
He advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
